notes.title: Version 3.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're pushing Version 3.1 out to fix some small bugs that popped up after we released Version 3.0.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[*]General Bug Fixes
[list][*]Fixed a bug that made Assassinate not count as melee damage toward the Tempest's shield.
[*]Fixed a bug with Assassinate that sometimes allowed the player to pass through walls.

notes.title: -Version 3.0- ANOMALY💥Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a while, but we have been hard at work on exciting new features and content. Today, we're introducing Version 3.0 [b]ANOMALY[/b]💥!

Check out the update trailer here:
[previewyoutube=ZEk8MTgGXwI;full][/previewyoutube]
This is an exciting one! We're introducing 2 brand new features: Anomaly waves and Last Chance upgrades, 2 new classes, a new ability, and a brand new enemy.

With these [b]new features[/b], we aimed to enhance the decision making process while picking upgrades by adding some exciting new stakes, as well as add some interesting new effects to play with. Anomaly waves can make [i]anything[/i] happen...!

We also introduced a new enemy: the [b]Seeker[/b]! 👁️
This high-speed enemy explodes into clouds of dangerous gas, that can harm you [i]and[/i] other enemies!

And we've also added two brand new classes: the [b]Assassin[/b], and the [b]Heavy Gunner[/b]!
Unlike existing classes, these new classes have different firing modes: a [b]burst fire[/b], and a [b]charge fire[/b]!

Some new achievements, and many other smaller changes and quality-of-life improvements are packed in as well. We hope everyone has fun with the new content! Take a look at the proper patch notes below.

Until next time!
-Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[*]Anomaly Waves
[*]Last Chance Upgrades
[*]"Go To Upgrade Machine" Button
[*] 9 new achievements

[b]New Classes:[/b]
[*]Heavy Gunner
[*]Assassin

[b]New Enemy:[/b] Seeker

[b]New Ability:[/b] Assassinate

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Changes to Enemies:[/b]
[*]Charger
[list][*]Reduced damage dealt.[/list]
[b]Changes to Abilities:[/b]
[*]Bullet Time
[list][*]Increased effect time.[/list]
[b]Changes to Classes:[/b]
[*]Brute
[list][*]Now starts with the Clash Parry upgrade.[/list]
[b]General Changes:[/b]
[*]Chain Lightning
[list][*]Decreased damage dealt.[/list]
[*]Upgrade Surge
[list][*]Increased cost scaling.[/list]
[*]First-Time User Experience
[list][*]Adjusted the first run pre-determined upgrades.[/list]
[*]Other
[list][*]Adjusted drop rates of some upgrades.
[*]Adjusted hit-stop effect for certain damage sources.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that caused some achievements not to properly trigger.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused scrolling UI elements to not sroll properly with a controller.
[*]Other various bug fixes

notes.title: Version 2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope everyone had a good holiday. We're releasing a small patch to fix some issues that popped up since our 2.0 update released. 

We're also currently working on the next major update! Thank you very much to everyone who's played so far. 

Until next time!
-Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]Changes to Enemies:[/b]

[*]Chaser
[list][*]Stage 2 damage dealt reduced from 25HP to 20HP.
[*]Stage 3 damage dealt reduced from 30HP to 25HP.
[*]Stage 4 damage dealt reduced from 40HP to 30HP.[/list]
[*]Spitter
[list][*]Will no longer initiate fire at the player from off-screen.[/list]

[list][*]Increased base reload speed to 2.5s from 3s.[/list]
[*]Light Gunner
[list][*]Increased base reload speed to 2.2s from 2.3s.[/list]
[b]Changes to Perks:[/b]
[*]Luck Boost
[list][*]Changed the function to make it more likely to see common upgrades occasionally.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that caused UI to display incorrectly on ultrawide displays.
[*]Other minor bug fixes[/list]

notes.title: -Version 2.0- SNOWSTORM❄️Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! It's been over a month since launch and we've loved every moment watching everyone explore Breach the Abyss. Just in time for winter, we're launching our [b]first major update[/b]- Version 2.0 [b]SNOWSTORM[/b]!❄️ Check out our update trailer here:

[previewyoutube=EnnhYoNQQ9k;full][/previewyoutube]

This update is cold as ice. We've added some electrifying new upgrades, a new class, a new ability, and some [i]cool[/i] new decorations, so now is a perfect time to jump back into the Abyss. 

With this update, we aimed to flesh out the ❄️[b]Freeze upgrade set[/b] with brand-new options that increase its depth and transforms it into an exciting tactical playstyle. We've also introduced [b]a brand-new set:⚡Lightning.[/b] This set focuses on long-range damage chains to help wipe out hordes of Abyssians with no sweat.

Outside of those, we have introduced a batch of standard upgrades, as well as the [b]Hailstorm ability[/b], and the [b]Grenadier class[/b]. 

We hope everyone has fun exploring this update! Once again, thank you to everyone who has played the game so far- it means the world to us. 

Until next time!
- Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]New Ability:[/b] Hailstorm

[b]New Class:[/b] Grenadier

[b]New Map Variant (Limited Time):[/b] Abyss (Snow)

[b]15 New Upgrades:[/b]
[*]Explosive Ice
[*]Tempered Ice
[*]Chilling Ice
[*]Chilling Shards
[*]Lightning Rounds
[*]Voltaic Counter
[*]Lightning Amp
[*]Current Up
[*]Excess Charge
[*]Clash Parry
[*]Energetic Parry
[*]Glass Cannon
[*]Opportunist
[*]Critical Eye
[*]Power Clash

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Changes to Perks:[/b]
[*]Power
[list][*]Increased max level from 4 to 5.[/list]
[*]Upgrade Surge
[list][*] Increased max level from 1 to 2.[/list]
[b]Changes to existing upgrades:[/b]
[*]Blizzard Parry
[list][*] Added a chance to freeze enemies upon parry.[/list]
[*]Electrostatic Touch
[list][*] Will now start a lightning chain upon activation.[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Breach the Abyss Patch 1.3 is now released![/b] This patch targets some bugs that slipped by our testing, as well as some quality-of-life changes for certain upgrades and abilities.

Full patch notes:

- Adjusted wave length to deliver a more consistent experience across all runs.

- Added additional functionality to the Auto-Turret ability which lets it ignore enemies it cannot retain line of sight on.

- Added additional functionality to the Auto-Turret ability which prevents it from being placed in invalid locations.

- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused [spoiler]The Tempest[/spoiler] to behave abnormally.

- Various other bug fixes.

Thanks for playing Breach the Abyss! We hope everyone has had lots of fun. There will be more to come, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Breach the Abyss is Now Available!
notes.content:
The time has finally come, and Breach the Abyss is finally released! It took a long time to get here, but we've overcome all in our path, and it's finally here.

We sincerely hope everyone has fun playing Breach the Abyss!!!! 

Plus, check out our brand new launch trailer!

[previewyoutube=TtVwKSKgLFY;full][/previewyoutube]

This won't be the end for Breach the Abyss, as we have some content planned for down the line.

Have fun, and enjoy!!!

-The Digital Firewood Team

notes.title: Breach the Abyss takes home awards at Level Up Showcase 2024!
notes.content:
[h1]We took home awards![/h1]

Hey Everyone! Thanks to everyone who's checked out the game so far. 

We recently attended [i][b]Level Up Showcase 2024[/b][/i], A showcase event for new developers all across Ontario. 

Out of 150+ Games at the event, we placed [b]2nd[/b] for [b]Best Overall Game[/b] and [b]3rd[/b] for [b]Best Artistic Achievement.[/b]

The team is super honoured to recieve these awards. Thanks to everyone who stopped by the event and played the game!

Rest assured this is not the end of the road, far from it. We're preparing for the full release of the game later this year, so please look forward to it!

Thank you!!!
